context: A screenshot of nyc-live, a 3D map of lower Manhattan centred on 598 Broadway, seen from above at an angle, in recorded mode (a saved MTA feed). The subway lines are drawn as thin tubes 12 m below street level in their official route colours, with small white station markers. Trains are drawn as short rectangular blocks, a little wider than the tubes and in their line's colour, placed along the lines from the feed. The venue is marked by a red pin on a red ring at the centre. The status line under the title at the top left lists what each layer has loaded.

checks.name: train_blocks_on_lines
checks.instructions: Several short, thick rectangular blocks sit on the coloured subway lines, each one lying along its line and coloured like a subway line (orange, green, blue, red or similar), like trains on the tracks.

checks.name: not_real_time_notice
checks.instructions: The status text at the top left says that the train positions may not be real time.
